shortDescription: Manages networks on the cloudscale.ch IaaS service

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for calls to the cloudscale.ch API. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TIMEOUT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: cloudscale.ch API token. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: api_url
options.description: cloudscale.ch API URL. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_URL) environment variable.

options.name: auto_create_ipv4_subnet
options.description: Whether to automatically create an IPv4 subnet in the network or not.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the network. Either I(name) or I(uuid) is required.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags assosiated with the networks. Set this to C({}) to clear any tags.

options.name: uuid
options.description: UUID of the network. Either I(name) or I(uuid) is required.

options.name: zone
options.description: Zone slug of the network (e.g. C(lpg1) or C(rma1)).
